subject: Money
title: Pump and Dump
description: Learn Pump and Dump in one minute.

hook.text: A crypto influencer promoted a token to 500,000 followers. Price spiked. He sold. It crashed 90%. He made $1.6 million.

buildup.text: Pump and dump: insiders buy cheap, promote loudly, wait for the price spike, then sell everything to latecomers.

discovery.text: Social media makes this trivially easy. One tweet from a large account can move a small token's price 500% in hours.

twist.text: In stocks, pump and dump is a federal crime. In crypto, enforcement is rare. The same scheme, different legal outcomes.

climax.text: If someone is loudly telling you to buy something, ask why. If they already own it, they profit from your purchase.

punchline.text: They pump. You buy. They dump. You hold.

quiz.question: Why is pump and dump common in crypto?
options: Enforcement is rare and social media makes it easy
